line.en: His earliest dated drawing, 5 August 1473: the Arno valley near Vinci, where he grew up.
line.de: Seine früheste datierte Zeichnung, 5. August 1473: das Arnotal bei Vinci, wo er aufwuchs.
line.certainty_note: The date and 'earliest dated' are documented by the holder; 'near Vinci, where he grew up' is likely when said loosely; the exact viewpoint is disputed and is not named.
